idea-plugin.name: Blockbench Idea
idea-plugin.description:
Open and edit Blockbench models directly inside IntelliJ IDEA, no external editor needed.

Double-clicking a .bbmodel file opens an editor tab with the Blockbench web app embedded via JCEF. The model is loaded from disk, and Ctrl/Cmd+S writes your changes back to the file. The Text tab stays available for raw JSON access.

The editor loads a local or self-hosted Blockbench web build. Configure BLOCKBENCH_URL or BLOCKBENCH_WEB_ROOT to select the runtime.
